visual_target: Across representative human rooms and miniature settlement views, use a restrained warm directional key, cooler neutral fill, controlled highlights, soft readable contact shadows, and a subdued cool room exterior. Keep the room materially credible and let existing settlement lamps separate the miniature world from the human room. Preserve all geometry, positions, material identities, and gameplay.
required_features: Pale room walls and floor retain tonal detail rather than clipping to white.
Furniture and settlement forms gain readable depth from directional light and grounded soft shadows.
Existing settlement lamps remain warmer than the room fill.
Exterior environment reads as subdued cool blue-gray without dominating the composition.
Same lighting direction and relative hierarchy hold in Room A, Room B, and the photo-derived room.
prohibited_changes: Do not change RoomDefinition geometry, dimensions, placements, collisions, navigation, interactions, or simulation.
Do not add or remove objects, meshes, lights, windows, texture detail, material colors, or decals as part of this lighting pass.
Do not introduce unsupported window-shaped shadow patterns.
Do not use material recoloring or added shader detail to claim a lighting improvement.
